title: Hook & Executive Overview
text: Hi, I am Srikanth Banoth, and this is SARAS ATLAS—a commerce resilience and decision intelligence platform that turns supply chain disruptions into mathematically optimized, financially reconciled decisions.

title: Disruption & Root Cause Analysis
text: In our synthetic scenario, a twenty-one-day supplier delay threatens five thousand units of inventory. Rather than just reporting lost sales, ATLAS decomposes our total two hundred twenty-four thousand, five hundred dollar gross exposure into five distinct root causes—including maritime surcharges, cross-zone shipping spillovers, and wasted digital ad burn.

title: SCIP Optimization Engine
text: To mitigate the crisis, we formulate a Mixed-Integer Linear Program solved with Google OR-Tools and SCIP. Under a strict forty thousand dollar capital budget, the solver proves the optimal policy: exhaust eight hundred units of cheap ground transfer, allocate two thousand nine hundred ninety-five units of air freight, and retain full ad velocity, investing thirty-nine thousand, nine hundred ninety-seven dollars and fifty cents with just two dollars and fifty cents in budget slack.

title: Financial Waterfall & Two-Man Governance
text: Our financial waterfall reconciles gross revenue against ninety-four thousand, six hundred dollars of avoided variable costs, protecting one hundred twenty-nine thousand, eight hundred forty-four dollars of true net contribution margin—a three point two five X ROI. And because capital exceeds twenty-five thousand dollars, our Two-Man Rule requires cryptographic dual-officer sign-off before execution.

title: Architecture & Closing
text: Built with Next.js fifteen, FastAPI, DuckDB, SQLite WAL, and OR-Tools, the entire backend runs on less than fifty megabytes of RAM. Check out the live application at saras-atlas.vercel.app or inspect the open-source codebase on GitHub. Thank you!
